not_a_variant_of: Do NOT mix reference images with the photoreal base character. That lockfile carries 'negative: no cartoon styling'. Face is derived from it; the two are separate assets.

render_target.medium: 3D computer-animated feature film character, modern CG pipeline
render_target.reference_register: Pixar / DreamWorks stylization: simplified forms, appealing silhouette, soft subsurface skin, no photoreal pores

measurement_system.base_unit: HW = head width, measured at the widest point of the cheekbones in front view
measurement_system.secondary_unit: HH = head height, chin base to crown of skull, hair excluded
measurement_system.why: Every facial value below is a ratio, not an adjective. Adjectives drift between renders. Ratios do not.

body_proportion.note: realistic human is 7.5 heads; 5.5 is the stylization
body_proportion.build: lean athletic, light muscle definition, no bulk
body_proportion.posture: relaxed, weight on one leg, shoulders down, chin level

skull.overall_shape: rounded ovoid, cranium noticeably larger than realistic, jaw noticeably smaller
skull.chin_shape: soft rounded square, no cleft, no point

face_thirds_front_view.note: top third is enlarged on purpose; that is the stylization handle

skull.eye_line_height: 0.46 HH measured up from chin base
skull.note_on_eye_line: below the vertical midpoint of the head, which forces the tall cranium that reads as animated

eyes.canthal_tilt_direction: outer corner higher than inner corner
eyes.catchlight: one primary specular dot upper-left of each iris, one faint secondary lower-right
eyes.lash_line: solid soft dark line on upper lid only, no individual lashes

brows.arch_peak_position: 65% along the brow measured from the inner end
brows.shape: clean straight-to-soft-arch, groomed, defined edge, not bushy

nose.bridge_profile: low and soft, no bony ridge
nose.nostril_shape: soft ovals angled 25 degrees from vertical, visible but small

mouth.resting_expression: closed mouth, faint neutral-friendly set, no visible teeth

cheeks_and_jaw.cheek_mass: full soft apple cheeks, rounded, no hollow under the bone
cheeks_and_jaw.jawline: softly defined, readable edge, never sharp or chiselled

profile_view_lock.why: front view alone lets the model re-invent the side; these values pin it
profile_view_lock.note: the back of the skull is large; that mass is what sells the stylization in profile

three_quarter_view_lock.far_cheek_silhouette: cheekbone breaks the face contour by 0.03 HW

hair.volume: zero lift, sits flat against the skull, follows the cranium silhouette exactly
hair.wave_pattern: subtle concentric ripple, rendered as a fine normal-map detail only, never as geometry
hair.sides: clean tapered fade down to bare skin at the temples and above the ears
hair.hairline: sharp lined-up front hairline, straight across, square corners at the temples
hair.surface: matte, no specular sheen, no individual strands
NOT: hair that rises above the skull silhouette

skin.subsurface_scattering: soft, warm red-orange, strongest at the ears, nose alae and finger edges
skin.surface: smooth stylized skin with a soft even sheen
skin.consistency_rule: hands, neck and ears use the identical albedo hex as the face

wardrobe_default.top: fitted plain black crewneck t-shirt, no logo, no text, soft cotton shading, short sleeves ending mid-bicep
wardrobe_default.bottom: black tapered joggers, soft fabric folds, cuffed at the ankle
wardrobe_default.shoes: clean plain black low-top sneakers, white sole
wardrobe_default.note: wardrobe is the one block you may swap per scene; everything above it stays frozen

lighting_default.key: soft large area light, 35 degrees camera-left, 20 degrees above eye level
lighting_default.fill: cool ambient bounce, 1:3 ratio to key
lighting_default.rim: warm narrow rim from behind camera-right, separates the head from the background
lighting_default.note: lighting is a style handle, not an identity handle; change it freely once the face is locked

negative_prompt: afro, volume on top, puffy hair, curls
logos or readable text anywhere in frame
teeth showing in a wide grin
skin tone on hands or neck different from the face
